fieldValues.title: Container.rootInstanceIds and Container.memberInstanceIds, when…
fieldValues.normative_statement: Every entry in `Container.memberInstanceIds` MUST have an `instanceId` that references a valid SRS instance ID (`Note.instanceId` or `Record.instanceId`), appearing exactly once and resolving to an instance ([R2]). This is required of every container, not only the root container; a dangling entry is a validation error, and the repair operation removes it ([R20]). `rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]).
